commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-none}"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1150/local-run; gh pr diff 1150 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1150/local-run/diff.patch | wc -l

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before &&
   [ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   [ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before; then
  echo "snapshot-ok"
else
  printf '%s\n' disabled > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled; echo "snapshot-failed"
fi
grep -n 'agent_overrides' …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for tok in 'R1' 'R3-tmp' 'I4' 'I5' 'IR1' 'IR2' 'IR4' 'shape 18' 'PreToolUse'; do
  echo "=== $tok ==="
  grep -n "$tok" docs/cloud-allowlist.md | grep -v "Denial-population\|928\|issue #1135" | head -6
done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
